claims.text: Most service businesses take longer than an hour to respond to a new lead
Responding within five minutes can roughly double the close rate compared to slower response times
More ad spend without faster follow-up wastes the added leads

No signup or payment card required to use the tool
Sequence can be produced and handed to a team the same day
